nodes.summary: For Hermitian matrices `A, B`, `λ_{a+b}(A + B) ≤ λ_a(A) + λ_b(B)` whenever `a + b < n`.
nodes.title: Weyl's inequality (upper bound), matrix form

nodes.summary: Eigenvalues are unchanged when the matrix is replaced by an equal matrix (useful to transport eigenvalue computations along identities such as `diagonal d₁ + diagonal d₂ = diagonal (d₁ + d₂)`).
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of equal Hermitian matrices agree

nodes.summary: The eigenvalues of a diagonal Hermitian matrix whose diagonal entries are already in decreasing order are exactly those entries.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of a diagonal matrix with decreasing entries

nodes.summary: For Hermitian matrices `A, B`, `λ_a(A) + λ_b(B) ≤ λ_{a+b-(n-1)}(A + B)` whenever `n - 1 ≤ a + b`.
nodes.title: Weyl's inequality (lower bound), matrix form

nodes.summary: For self-adjoint operators `T, S`, `λ_a(T) + λ_b(S) ≤ λ_{a+b-(n-1)}(T + S)` whenever `n - 1 ≤ a + b`.
nodes.title: Weyl's inequality (lower bound)

nodes.summary: For self-adjoint operators `T, S`, `λ_{a+b}(T + S) ≤ λ_a(T) + λ_b(S)` whenever `a + b < n`.
nodes.title: Weyl's inequality (upper bound)

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be Hermitian $n \times n$ complex matrices, and let $\lambda_1(A) \ge \dots \ge \lambda_n(A)$ and $\lambda_1(B) \ge \dots \ge \lambda_n(B)$ be their eigenvalues, listed with multiplicity in decreasing order. Then $|\lambda_i(A) - \lambda_i(B)| \le \|A - B\|$ for every $i$, where $\|A - B\|$ is the operator norm of $A - B$ acting on $\mathbb{C}^n$ with the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Weyl's perturbation inequality

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
